5: package org.mozilla.fenix.shopping.middleware
6: 
7: import android.content.Context
8: import androidx.navigation.NavController
9: import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
10: import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
11: import mozilla.components.feature.session.SessionUseCases
12: import mozilla.components.feature.tabs.TabsUseCases
13: import mozilla.components.lib.state.Middleware
14: import mozilla.components.lib.state.MiddlewareContext
15: import org.mozilla.fenix.NavGraphDirections
16: import org.mozilla.fenix.settings.SupportUtils
17: import org.mozilla.fenix.shopping.store.ReviewQualityCheckAction
18: import org.mozilla.fenix.shopping.store.ReviewQualityCheckState
19: 
20: /**
21:  * Middleware that handles navigation events for the review quality check feature.
22:  *
23:  * @property selectOrAddUseCase UseCase instance used to open new tabs.
24:  * @property loadUrlUseCase UseCase instance used to load url in the current tab.
25:  * @property navController Navigation controller used to navigate between fragments.
26:  * @property scope [CoroutineScope] used to launch coroutines.
27:  */
28: class ReviewQualityCheckNavigationMiddleware(
29:     private val selectOrAddUseCase: TabsUseCases.SelectOrAddUseCase,
30:     private val loadUrlUseCase: SessionUseCases.LoadUrlUseCase,
31:     private val navController: NavController,
32:     private val scope: CoroutineScope,
33: ) : Middleware<ReviewQualityCheckState, ReviewQualityCheckAction> {
34: 
35:     override fun invoke(
36:         context: MiddlewareContext<ReviewQualityCheckState, ReviewQualityCheckAction>,
37:         next: (ReviewQualityCheckAction) -> Unit,
38:         action: ReviewQualityCheckAction,
39:     ) {
40:         next(action)
41:         when (action) {
42:             is ReviewQualityCheckAction.NavigationMiddlewareAction -> processAction(action)
43:             else -> {
44:                 // no-op
45:             }
46:         }
47:     }
48: 
49:     private fun processAction(
50:         action: ReviewQualityCheckAction.NavigationMiddlewareAction,
51:     ) = scope.launch {
52:         when (action) {
53:             is ReviewQualityCheckAction.OpenLink -> {
54:                 when (action.link) {
55:                     is LinkType.ExternalLink -> {
56:                         selectOrAddUseCase.invoke(url = action.link.url)
57:                     }
58: 
59:                     is LinkType.AnalyzeLink -> {
60:                         loadUrlUseCase.invoke(url = action.link.url)
61:                     }
62:                 }
63:                 navController.navigate(NavGraphDirections.actionGlobalBrowser(null))
64:             }
65:         }
66:     }
67: 
68:     /**
69:      * Types of links that can be opened from the review quality check feature.
70:      */
71:     sealed class LinkType {
72:         /**
73:          * Opens a link to analyze a product.
74:          */
75:         data class AnalyzeLink(val url: String) : LinkType()
76: 
77:         /**
78:          * Opens an external "Learn more" link.
79:          */
80:         abstract class ExternalLink : LinkType() {
81:             abstract var url: String
82:         }
83: 
84:         /**
85:          * Opens the learn more link from the explainer card.
86:          */
87:         class ExplainerLearnMore(context: Context) : ExternalLink() {
88:             override var url: String = SupportUtils.getSumoURLForTopic(
89:                 context,
90:                 SupportUtils.SumoTopic.HELP,
91:             )
92:         }
93: 
94:         /**
95:          * Opens the powered by link.
96:          */
97:         class PoweredBy : ExternalLink() {
98:             override var url: String = "http://fakespot.com/"
99:         }
100:     }

26: /**
27:  * A bottom sheet fragment displaying Review Quality Check information.
28:  */
29: class ReviewQualityCheckFragment : BottomSheetDialogFragment() {
30: 
31:     private var behavior: BottomSheetBehavior<View>? = null
32:     private val store by lazy {
33:         ReviewQualityCheckStore(
34:             middleware = ReviewQualityCheckMiddlewareProvider.provideMiddleware(
35:                 settings = requireComponents.settings,
36:                 browserStore = requireComponents.core.store,
37:                 context = requireContext(),
38:                 navController = findNavController(),
39:                 scope = lifecycleScope,
40:             ),
41:         )
42:     }
43: 
44:     override fun onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState: Bundle?): Dialog =
45:         super.onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState).apply {
46:             setOnShowListener {
47:                 val bottomSheet =
48:                     findViewById<View?>(com.google.android.material.R.id.design_bottom_sheet)
49:                 bottomSheet?.setBackgroundResource(android.R.color.transparent)
50:                 behavior = BottomSheetBehavior.from(bottomSheet)
51:             }
52:         }
53: 
54:     override fun onCreateView(
55:         inflater: LayoutInflater,
56:         container: ViewGroup?,
57:         savedInstanceState: Bundle?,
58:     ): View = ComposeView(requireContext()).apply {
59:         setContent {
60:             FirefoxTheme {
61:                 ReviewQualityCheckBottomSheet(
62:                     store = store,
63:                     onRequestDismiss = {
64:                         behavior?.state = BottomSheetBehavior.STATE_HIDDEN
65:                     },
66:                     modifier = Modifier.nestedScroll(rememberNestedScrollInteropConnection()),
67:                 )
68:             }
69:         }
70:     }
71: }

5: package org.mozilla.fenix.shopping

7: import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
8: import kotlinx.coroutines.cancel
9: import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.distinctUntilChanged
10: import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
11: import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.mapNotNull
12: import mozilla.components.browser.state.selector.selectedTab
13: import mozilla.components.browser.state.store.BrowserStore
14: import mozilla.components.lib.state.ext.flowScoped
15: import mozilla.components.support.base.feature.LifecycleAwareFeature
16: 
17: /**
18:  * Feature implementation that provides review quality check information for supported product
19:  * pages.
20:  *
21:  * @property browserStore Reference to the application's [BrowserStore].
22:  * @property shoppingExperienceFeature Reference to the [ShoppingExperienceFeature].
23:  * @property onAvailabilityChange Invoked when availability of this feature changes based on feature
24:  * flag and when the loaded page is a supported product page.
25:  */
26: class ReviewQualityCheckFeature(
27:     private val browserStore: BrowserStore,
28:     private val shoppingExperienceFeature: ShoppingExperienceFeature,
29:     private val onAvailabilityChange: (isAvailable: Boolean) -> Unit,
30: ) : LifecycleAwareFeature {
31:     private var scope: CoroutineScope? = null
32: 
33:     override fun start() {
34:         if (!shoppingExperienceFeature.isEnabled) {
35:             onAvailabilityChange(false)
36:             return
37:         }
38: 
39:         scope = browserStore.flowScoped { flow ->
40:             flow.mapNotNull { it.selectedTab }
41:                 .map { it.isProductUrl }
42:                 .distinctUntilChanged()
43:                 .collect(onAvailabilityChange)
44:         }
45:     }
46: 
47:     override fun stop() {
48:         scope?.cancel()
49:     }
50: }

7: import androidx.compose.animation.Crossfade
8: import androidx.compose.animation.animateContentSize

10: import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
11: import androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect
12: import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
13: import androidx.compose.runtime.remember

15: import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
16: import mozilla.components.lib.state.ext.observeAsState
17: import org.mozilla.fenix.shopping.middleware.ReviewQualityCheckNavigationMiddleware
18: import org.mozilla.fenix.shopping.store.ReviewQualityCheckAction
19: import org.mozilla.fenix.shopping.store.ReviewQualityCheckState
20: import org.mozilla.fenix.shopping.store.ReviewQualityCheckState.OptedIn.ProductReviewState.AnalysisPresent
21: import org.mozilla.fenix.shopping.store.ReviewQualityCheckStore
22: 
23: /**
24:  * Top-level UI for the Review Quality Check feature.
25:  *
26:  * @param store [ReviewQualityCheckStore] that holds the state.
27:  * @param onRequestDismiss Invoked when a user action requests dismissal of the bottom sheet.
28:  * @param modifier The modifier to be applied to the Composable.
29:  */
30: @Composable
31: fun ReviewQualityCheckBottomSheet(
32:     store: ReviewQualityCheckStore,
33:     onRequestDismiss: () -> Unit,
34:     modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
35: ) {
36:     val reviewQualityCheckState by store.observeAsState(ReviewQualityCheckState.Initial) { it }
37:     val isOptedIn =
38:         remember(reviewQualityCheckState) { reviewQualityCheckState is ReviewQualityCheckState.OptedIn }
39: 
40:     ReviewQualityCheckScaffold(
41:         onRequestDismiss = onRequestDismiss,
42:         modifier = modifier.animateContentSize(),
43:     ) {
44:         val context = LocalContext.current
45: 
46:         when (val state = reviewQualityCheckState) {
47:             is ReviewQualityCheckState.NotOptedIn -> {
48:                 ReviewQualityCheckContextualOnboarding(
49:                     onPrimaryButtonClick = {
50:                         store.dispatch(ReviewQualityCheckAction.OptIn)
51:                     },
52:                     onSecondaryButtonClick = onRequestDismiss,
53:                 )
54:             }
55: 
56:             is ReviewQualityCheckState.OptedIn -> {
57:                 ProductReview(
58:                     state = state,
59:                     onOptOutClick = {
60:                         onRequestDismiss()
61:                         store.dispatch(ReviewQualityCheckAction.OptOut)
62:                     },
63:                     onReanalyzeClick = {
64:                         store.dispatch(ReviewQualityCheckAction.ReanalyzeProduct)
65:                     },
66:                     onProductRecommendationsEnabledStateChange = {
67:                         store.dispatch(ReviewQualityCheckAction.ToggleProductRecommendation)
68:                     },
69:                     onReviewGradeLearnMoreClick = {
70:                         store.dispatch(
71:                             ReviewQualityCheckAction.OpenLink(
72:                                 ReviewQualityCheckNavigationMiddleware.LinkType.ExplainerLearnMore(context),
73:                             ),
74:                         )
75:                     },
76:                     onFooterLinkClick = {
77:                         store.dispatch(
78:                             ReviewQualityCheckAction.OpenLink(
79:                                 ReviewQualityCheckNavigationMiddleware.LinkType.PoweredBy(),
80:                             ),
81:                         )
82:                     },
83:                 )
84:             }
85: 
86:             is ReviewQualityCheckState.Initial -> {}
87:         }
88:     }
89: 
90:     LaunchedEffect(isOptedIn) {
91:         if (isOptedIn) {
92:             store.dispatch(ReviewQualityCheckAction.FetchProductAnalysis)
93:         }
94:     }
95: }
96: 
97: @Composable
98: @Suppress("LongParameterList")
99: private fun ProductReview(
100:     state: ReviewQualityCheckState.OptedIn,
101:     onOptOutClick: () -> Unit,
102:     onReanalyzeClick: () -> Unit,
103:     onProductRecommendationsEnabledStateChange: (Boolean) -> Unit,
104:     onReviewGradeLearnMoreClick: () -> Unit,
105:     onFooterLinkClick: () -> Unit,
106: ) {
107:     Crossfade(
108:         targetState = state.productReviewState,
109:         label = "ProductReview-Crossfade",
110:     ) { productReviewState ->
111:         when (productReviewState) {
112:             is AnalysisPresent -> {
113:                 ProductAnalysis(
114:                     productRecommendationsEnabled = state.productRecommendationsPreference,
115:                     productAnalysis = productReviewState,
116:                     onOptOutClick = onOptOutClick,
117:                     onReanalyzeClick = onReanalyzeClick,
118:                     onProductRecommendationsEnabledStateChange = onProductRecommendationsEnabledStateChange,
119:                     onReviewGradeLearnMoreClick = onReviewGradeLearnMoreClick,
120:                     onFooterLinkClick = onFooterLinkClick,
121:                 )
122:             }
123: 
124:             is ReviewQualityCheckState.OptedIn.ProductReviewState.Error -> {
125:                 ProductAnalysisError(
126:                     productRecommendationsEnabled = state.productRecommendationsPreference,
127:                     onReviewGradeLearnMoreClick = onReviewGradeLearnMoreClick,
128:                     onOptOutClick = onOptOutClick,
129:                     onProductRecommendationsEnabledStateChange = onProductRecommendationsEnabledStateChange,
130:                     onFooterLinkClick = onFooterLinkClick,
131:                     modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
132:                 )
133:             }
134: 
135:             is ReviewQualityCheckState.OptedIn.ProductReviewState.Loading -> {
136:                 ProductReviewLoading()
137:             }
138: 
139:             is ReviewQualityCheckState.OptedIn.ProductReviewState.NoAnalysisPresent -> {
140:                 NoAnalysis(
141:                     productRecommendationsEnabled = state.productRecommendationsPreference,
142:                     isAnalyzing = productReviewState.isReanalyzing,
143:                     onAnalyzeClick = onReanalyzeClick,
144:                     onReviewGradeLearnMoreClick = onReviewGradeLearnMoreClick,
145:                     onOptOutClick = onOptOutClick,
146:                     onProductRecommendationsEnabledStateChange = onProductRecommendationsEnabledStateChange,
147:                     modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
148:                 )
149:             }
150:         }
151:     }
152: }
